Pattern of labeled sections ("Review") suggests a structured document or prompt template, with "Previous: Review\n" establishing a repetition/continuation pattern.

The informal, fragmented style ("code is wrong", "Review") signals a casual AI prompt or chat log context, where the model is expected to continue generating similar short instructional or reflective content.

"## Review" is a markdown heading, directly mirroring the prior "Review" label, suggesting the next token continues this heading or begins a new section body — likely a colon, question, or continuation of the "Review" concept.
"Previous: Review\n## Review" establishes a parallel structure, so the next tokens likely complete a heading or introduce a lesson-recap prompt, e.g., "of previous concepts" or "Exercise."
"## Review" is a new heading, expecting continuation.</explanation>
